text: {"lessons":["I will base trades on future prospects and portfolio risk, not on whether a position is above or below my average cost; past price movements do not predict future ones.","Taking a gain felt satisfying, but I should not sell merely to lock in a profit—nor hold a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake.","I will avoid reacting to one month’s account change and trade only when my goals, diversification, or assessment of risk give me a clear reason."]}
